paragraphs: Silver coloured wheelwork reads as instrument rather than as ornament. Where brass suggests the workshop and the nineteenth century, a bright steel finish suggests precision measurement, which is why scientific apparatus and watch movements look so different from each other.
The model holds 85,497 polygons and 84,756 vertices in quads and tris with non-overlapping UVs, and carries CheckMate Lite and Pro certification.
At $59 it suits technology and engineering illustration, museum and exhibition work, advertising metaphor imagery, film props, game environments and editorial work. On sale since 2021.

Clothing worn continuously wears in a particular way: at the shoulders where a bag sits, at the cuffs, at the hem. Depicting that honestly matters, because a character in clean garments read as poor by colour alone is a costume rather than a person.
The garment set holds 26,490 polygons and 26,426 vertices in quads and tris with non-overlapping UVs, and carries StemCell certification.
At $59 it suits character wardrobe work, film and television costume, social and documentary illustration, game characters, education material and editorial work. On sale since 2024.

The hognose is famous for bluffing. It flattens its neck, hisses, strikes with its mouth closed, and if none of that works it rolls over and plays dead convincingly enough to fool almost anything. The upturned snout it is named for is a digging tool.

The model is extremely light at 4,220 polygons and 4,225 vertices in quads and tris with non-overlapping UVs, textured with 6 maps all at 4096x4096, in a coiled pose. It carries StemCell certification, and red and brown builds are offered separately.
At $59 it suits wildlife and nature visualisation, education and documentary work, terrarium and pet material, game creatures, advertising and editorial illustration. On sale since 2020.

A stabilised sensor ball is a gyroscope with cameras inside it. The aircraft moves, vibrates and turns, and the sphere stays pointed at the same square metre of ground, which is the only reason airborne imagery is usable at all.

The model holds 51,146 polygons and 52,485 vertices in quads and tris with non-overlapping UVs. It carries CheckMate Lite and Pro certification, and further builds of the system are offered separately.
At $59 it suits aviation and defence equipment visualisation, law enforcement and surveillance presentation, equipment marketing, training material and editorial illustration. On sale since 2022.

A hydraulic bench press turns a person's arm into several tonnes of force, and it does it with a lever and a small piston. It is the clearest demonstration of hydraulics anyone will meet outside a textbook, sitting on a workshop bench.
The model is light at 32,180 polygons and 32,973 vertices in quads and tris with non-overlapping UVs, so it fits easily into a workshop scene. It carries CheckMate Lite and Pro certification.
At $59 it suits workshop and manufacturing visualisation, tool and equipment marketing, training material, e-commerce imagery, film sets and game environments. On sale since 2021.

A paediatric typodont has to show two sets of teeth at once: the milk teeth in place and the permanent ones waiting above them. Removable teeth are what make that explainable, because the whole question a parent asks is what is happening underneath.

The model is very light at 14,196 polygons and 7,332 vertices in quads and tris with non-overlapping UVs, with removable teeth, so it runs in interactive material. It carries CheckMate Lite and Pro certification.
At $59 it suits dental and paediatric education, patient and parent explanation, clinic marketing, interactive learning apps and editorial illustration. On sale since 2023.

Showing a printer with something on the bed is the whole difference between a machine and a process. The figurine is the argument: this is what came out, this is roughly how long it took, and this is why the thing is on the desk at all.
The model holds 287,874 polygons and 291,007 vertices in quads and tris with overlapping UVs, in black, supplied with the printed figurine. It is built to CheckMate specification.
At $59 it suits product and technology visualisation, e-commerce and retail imagery, maker and education material, office and workshop scenes, and editorial illustration. On sale since 2026.

Parcel delivery by drone has been trialled for over a decade and remains mostly trials, because the hard part was never flying. It is weather, airspace, noise and what happens when a package has to be left somewhere nobody is standing.
The model is built at subdivision level, 42,872 polygons and 44,298 vertices with non-overlapping UVs, so it holds up close. It carries CheckMate Lite and Pro certification.
At $59 it suits logistics and future mobility visualisation, technology presentation, news and documentary graphics, advertising, game environments and editorial illustration. On sale since 2020.

A lead is a communication device rather than a restraint, which is why the hardware matters so much: the clip, the width, the length and whether it gives at all decide how much the dog on the end of it can actually tell the person holding it.
This is a collection listing rather than a single object, supplying collars and leashes as static pieces. It carries CheckMate Lite and Pro certification.
At $59 the set suits pet product and retail visualisation, e-commerce imagery, advertising, character accessories, film props and editorial illustration. On sale since 2015.

The fruit fly has done more for genetics than any other animal. It breeds in days, its chromosomes are large enough to see, and almost everything known about how genes control development was worked out on this insect first.
The model is light at 14,822 polygons and 15,232 vertices in quads and tris with non-overlapping UVs, in black. It is built to CheckMate specification.
At $59 it suits scientific and education visualisation, laboratory and research material, museum work, documentary graphics, game assets and editorial illustration. On sale since 2025.

An old face is a record of muscle use. The lines that form are the ones a person made most often, which is why two people the same age can look nothing alike and why a generic ageing pass over a young model never quite convinces.

This is the lighter of the two elderly head models in the library, built at subdivision level with 4,679 polygons and 5,188 vertices and non-overlapping UVs, so it smooths cleanly to any resolution. It carries StemCell certification.
At $59 it suits character development and sculpting reference, medical and ageing visualisation, education material, game and film assets, and editorial illustration. On sale since 2021.

Modelling age means modelling what happens under the skin rather than on it. Fat pads move down, the bone becomes more visible at the temple and the jaw, and the skin follows all of that rather than simply creasing.
This build holds 13,675 polygons and 28,007 vertices in quads and tris with non-overlapping UVs, and carries StemCell certification. A lighter subdivision head is also available in the library.
At $59 it suits character development and sculpting reference, medical and ageing visualisation, education material, game and film assets, and editorial illustration. On sale since 2025.

A vaping kit is a battery, a coil and a tank, and the entire product category is an argument about that arrangement. The design language borrowed from consumer electronics rather than from tobacco, which was a deliberate positioning decision.
The set is extremely light at 2,327 polygons and 2,303 vertices in quads and tris with non-overlapping UVs, textured with 6 maps all at 4096x4096. It carries CheckMate Lite and Pro certification.
At $59 it suits product and packaging visualisation, e-commerce and retail imagery, advertising, public health material, film props and editorial illustration. On sale since 2020.

Putting a screen on a fridge door was mocked and then quietly copied by everyone, because the fridge turned out to be the one appliance the whole household stands in front of every day. French doors are there for the same reason: they open in a narrow kitchen.
The model holds 271,307 polygons and 275,472 vertices in quads and tris with non-overlapping UVs, textured with 13 maps all at 4096x4096. It carries CheckMate Lite and Pro certification.
At $59 it suits kitchen and interior visualisation, appliance marketing and e-commerce imagery, advertising, film sets, game environments and editorial illustration. On sale since 2018.
